WITH completed AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) AS delivery_date,
    order_estimated_delivery_date,
    CASE WHEN CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_late
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
),
window_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS completed_deliveries,
    SUM(is_late) AS late_deliveries,
    ROUND(SUM(is_late)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS late_share
  FROM completed
  WHERE delivery_date >= DATE '2018-05-28' AND delivery_date < DATE '2018-06-04'
),
baseline_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS completed_deliveries,
    SUM(is_late) AS late_deliveries,
    ROUND(SUM(is_late)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS late_share
  FROM completed
  WHERE delivery_date >= DATE '2018-05-21' AND delivery_date < DATE '2018-05-28'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(w.late_share, 4) AS value,
  ROUND(b.late_share, 4) AS baseline,
  w.completed_deliveries AS window_completed,
  w.late_deliveries AS window_late,
  b.completed_deliveries AS baseline_completed,
  b.late_deliveries AS baseline_late
FROM window_stats w, baseline_stats b;
